question: Where is the fimbrial end relative to the ovary?
questionZh: 输卵管伞端在卵巢的什么位置？

orientation.heading: Orient in the pelvis
orientation.cue: Start at the purple uterus. Follow each tube outward to its gold fringed end beside a blue ovary.
orientation.cueZh: 从紫色子宫出发，沿两侧输卵管向外，找到蓝色卵巢旁金黄色的伞端。

plate.title: Female pelvic assembly, anterior view
plate.titleZh: 女性盆腔组合模型，前视图
plate.alt: The tubes extend from the central uterus to the blue ovaries and gold fringes at the outer ends.

localization.heading: Find the fringe and the gap
localization.transition: Switch from the pelvic assembly to enlarged views of the HRA-derived teaching ovoid r02. The camera framing and scale change.
localization.transitionZh: 接下来切换到基于 HRA 来源的 r02 卵巢教学模型放大图。取景范围和比例均有变化。
localization.cue: In each column, find the pale ovary and the pink finger-like fimbriae. Use the lower views to point to the dark space between them. L and R are the source labels.
localization.cueZh: 在每列找出浅色卵巢和粉色指状伞缘，再用下排视图指出两者之间的暗色间隙。L 和 R 沿用来源的左右标记。
localization.limit: Only the ovary exteriors are interpreted. The tube contours are preserved from HRA. These views show gross placement. Tissue attachment and lumen continuity remain unresolved.
localization.limitZh: 卵巢外形经过教学性处理，输卵管轮廓保留自 HRA。这些图用于观察大体位置关系，组织附着与管腔连续性尚未确定。

plate.title: Teaching ovoid r02, source L and R
plate.titleZh: r02 卵巢教学模型，来源 L 和 R
plate.alt: The native and alternate views show the pink fimbrial tips across a dark gap from each pale ovary. Alternate views make the gap easier to see.

source.heading: Compare with source (HRA r01)
source.cue: In the native overview, Source R is image-left and Source L is image-right. In the two enlarged views, 1 marks the ovary and 2 marks the fimbrial end. The source sheet preserves the cut ends and gaps.
source.cueZh: 原生总览中，来源 R 在画面左侧，来源 L 在右侧。两幅放大图中，1 指向卵巢，2 指向输卵管伞端。原图保留来源模型的截断边缘和间隙。
source.credit: Ovary v1.3 and fallopian tube v1.2 by Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein, HuBMAP Human Reference Atlas, CC BY 4.0.
source.creditZh: 卵巢 v1.3 与输卵管 v1.2 由 Kristen Browne 和 Heidi Schlehlein 制作，来源为 HuBMAP 人体参考图谱，采用 CC BY 4.0 许可。

plate.title: Native HRA overview and enlarged side views
plate.titleZh: HRA 原生总览与两侧放大图
plate.alt: The native overview shows both ovaries and tubal ends. The enlarged views mark the ovaries with 1 and the fimbrial ends with 2.
